title: Bridging the Last Mile of Time Series Forecasting with LLM Agents

claim.summary: The last-mile framework revises an immutable baseline forecast through constrained workspace actions, event-window planning and outcome-grounded memory.

modules.name: Immutable baseline and constrained forecast edits
modules.scope_reason: Workspace invariants and action operators explicitly preserve observed history and restrict modifications to forecast horizons.
evidence_locators: PDF p.3; passage beginning "The historical series"

modules.name: Outcome-grounded forecast revision memory
modules.scope_reason: Memory stores realized event magnitude and whether a previous forecast adjustment improved prediction.
evidence_locators: PDF p.5; passage beginning "Once actual values become available"

modules.name: Event-window map-reduce revision planning
modules.scope_reason: Local reasoners propose revisions for future event windows; accepted plans update the same forecast workspace.
evidence_locators: PDF p.4; passage beginning "To keep the revision process focused"
